_about: v15 review round (notes/ui-redesign-2/ledger-v15.json): the strings the review fixes add. id -> {en, ru, plural?, en_plural?, ctx?, note}. Russian follows notes/i18n/GLOSSARY.md. Read by tools/make_ru_table.py (v15-*.json).

v15r.bind_novalue.note: Shapes list row: a field bound to a formula of shared numbers that has no value now (math-2); the shape is not drawn.

v15r.bind_count.en: a count is a whole number from 1 to 60
v15r.bind_count.note: Reason after "n = …: " for a grid count out of range (math-2).

v15r.zp_hint_touch.en: Or long-press a plane. Marks snap to the ruler.
v15r.zp_hint_touch.ru: Или удерживайте палец на плоскости. Метки привязываются к линейке.
v15r.zp_hint_touch.note: Inspector hint under Add zero / Add pole on touch screens (design-9, russian-8; GLOSSARY 3.12).

v15r.mob_const.note: Inspector, a Möbius step with ad − bc = 0 and c = 0 (math-6, verify-3). {f} is f with the step's index (HTML), {v} a number.

v15r.mob_const_rem.en: {f} is constant (= {v}); {z} = {p} is a removable singularity.
v15r.mob_const_rem.note: Inspector, a Möbius step with ad − bc = 0 (math-6, verify-3): the point −d/c is a removable singularity. {f} and {z} are italic letters (HTML), {v} and {p} numbers.

v15r.insert_after.note: Step ⋯ menu: the keyboard way to the connectors’ insert + (design-14). «него»: the step (шаг).

v15r.chain_more.note: aria-label of the chain head’s ⋯ (holds Clear chain; design-18).

v15r.cyr_name.en: The letter “{x}” is Cyrillic: names are written in Latin letters. Switch the keyboard layout.
v15r.cyr_name.ru: Буква «%{x}» — русская: имена пишутся латиницей. Переключите раскладку.
v15r.cyr_name.note: Parameters, + Number: a Cyrillic letter that is not a look-alike of a Latin one (russian-7).

v15r.every_point.en: every point maps here: an earlier step is constant
v15r.every_point.ru: сюда переходит любая точка: один из предыдущих шагов постоянен
v15r.every_point.note: Plane menu, muted line under Add zero/pole of fₖ here (math-6, math-12).

v15r.also_mult.en: also at {n} other point, counted with multiplicity
en_plural: also at {n} other point, counted with multiplicity
also at {n} other points, counted with multiplicity

plural.one: ещё в %{n} точке с учётом кратности
plural.few: ещё в %{n} точках с учётом кратности
plural.many: ещё в %{n} точках с учётом кратности
plural.other: ещё в %{n} точках с учётом кратности

v15r.also_mult.note: Plane menu muted line for polynomial and rational steps (math-12; russian-13a: no «также ещё»).

v15r.f_there.note: Plane menu muted line when active steps follow fₖ (math-4): the value of F at the new zero. {f} is f with a subscript (HTML).

v15r.added_zero_at.note: Announcement after the plane menu adds a zero (regress-10, russian-13b).

v15r.added_pole_at.note: Announcement after the plane menu adds a pole.

v15r.added_zero.note: Announcement after the Inspector’s Add zero (regress-10).

v15r.added_pole.note: Announcement after the Inspector’s Add pole.

v15r.all_z.note: Inspector, F: after «Естественная область определения D: » (russian-11: lower case after a colon).
